top_creatures.label: Corpse-tether healer
top_creatures.why: Revives a fallen enemy by tethering the corpse; the threat returns, which is a state change, not only damage.
top_creatures.keep: Frame-gated channel, 256-unit reach limit, 45-degree pitch gate, revive flag set on the target (game/m_medic.c 576-628, ED_CallSpawn at 621)
top_creatures.change: Revive comes back at partial HP after a visible wind-up, with a rope of light instead of a cable

top_creatures.label: Latch leech
top_creatures.why: Holds the player and drains, so the threat is a state as well as damage.
top_creatures.keep: Latch state and frame-gated drain ticks (5 on drain03, 2 on drain04)
top_creatures.change: Silhouette and drain cue (a crystal hum)

top_creatures.label: Guard-stance brute
top_creatures.why: A visible guard pose before attacks is a readable telegraph.
top_creatures.keep: Duck telegraph and dodge pause of time-to-impact plus 0.5 s
top_creatures.change: The guard flashes a shield rather than a head shape

top_creatures.label: Three-tier grunt
top_creatures.why: Three tiers from one model and skin, with HP steps of 20, 30 and 40.
top_creatures.keep: Tier as skin variant and HP step; shared gib threshold of -30; skill-driven response
top_creatures.change: Tier shows as an armour plate tint and a different sidearm

top_creatures.label: Halo colossus
top_creatures.why: A 3000 HP boss with a BFG and firebullet bursts.
top_creatures.keep: BFG as a big slow shot; boss gib threshold far below zero so it dies by finisher
top_creatures.change: Ranged signature is a sweep of arcs, not a plain volley

top_creatures.label: Twin-gun warlord
top_creatures.why: A visible railgun wind-up followed by a BFG.
top_creatures.change: No respawn call; a stance change at half HP

top_creatures.label: Armoured walker pair
top_creatures.why: An elite is the same model with a different skin and more HP (1000 against 750).
top_creatures.keep: Elite as data change: HP, gib threshold and skin
top_creatures.change: A shield plate and a colour-coded readability ring

top_creatures.label: Leaping brute
top_creatures.why: A take-off then a touch-jump is a readable telegraph.
top_creatures.change: Landing shockwave in place of the claw attack

classes: No player classes in the code read (game/p_client.c, game/p_weapon.c): one player class, no races

weapon_families: Rocket launcher: 100 plus 0-19 random, radius damage 120 (game/p_weapon.c 764-783)
Blaster: 15 deathmatch, 10 otherwise (game/p_weapon.c 852-855); hyperblaster 15 deathmatch, 20 otherwise (904-907)
Shotgun: 4 per pellet (game/p_weapon.c 1189-1215); super shotgun: 6 per pellet (1245-1269)
Railgun: 150 (100 deathmatch), kick 250 (200), pierces monsters and players, stops at walls, passes liquid (game/p_weapon.c 1312-1317; game/g_weapon.c 658-718)
BFG: 200 deathmatch, 500 otherwise, radius 1000; after impact a per-tick laser sweep at targets within 256 units, 10 per tick (5 deathmatch) (game/p_weapon.c 1372-1377; game/g_weapon.c 804-881)
Quad damage multiplies damage by 4 at fire time (game/p_weapon.c 558, 719)
gear_tiers: Jacket armour: base 25, max 50, 30 percent normal, 0 percent energy (game/g_items.c 39)
Combat armour: base 50, max 100, 60 percent normal, 30 percent energy (game/g_items.c 40)
Body armour: base 100, max 200, 80 percent normal, 60 percent energy (game/g_items.c 41); each tier has its own pickup model with EF_ROTATE (game/g_items.c 1153)
Armour shard: small armour pickup (game/g_items.c, item_armor_shard)
Power screen: front arc only (dot above 0.3), absorbs damage/3, one cell per point (game/g_combat.c 223-243)
Power shield: all directions, two cells per point, absorbs two thirds of damage (game/g_combat.c 232-237)
Quad damage: 4x per shot; picking up another quad adds time (game/g_items.c 355-360)
Invulnerability: blocks damage, sound throttle 2 s on the protected target (game/g_combat.c T_Damage)

looks.label: BFG laser sweep
looks.technique: Per-tick traces from the ball to each target in radius; temp-entity laser per trace with sparks on walls

looks.label: Railgun trail with liquid double
looks.technique: One trail from the muzzle to the end; a second trail is sent when the beam crossed water or lava

looks.label: Power armour sparks
looks.technique: Separate spark temp-entities for screen (1 cell per point) and shield (2 cells per point)

looks.label: Medic cable
looks.technique: Temp-entity beam from the medic to the corpse, sent on each cable frame

looks.label: Parasite drain beam
looks.technique: Temp-entity beam on the drain frame; damage applied only when the trace hits the target

looks.label: Obituary variety
looks.technique: 40 obituary strings chosen by means of death, including a dodge kill line

originals.name: Halo bombard
originals.idea: A slow orb that, each tick, lays a short laser sweep at every target within a radius and pierces through the first target.
originals.keep: Per-tick pulse, radius gate and pierce (game/g_weapon.c 804-881)
originals.change: A fan of arcs and a charge-up sound

originals.name: Front-arc shield
originals.idea: Blocks hits only from the front arc and costs one charge per point.
originals.keep: The arc test by dot product and the charge cost (game/g_combat.c 223-237)
originals.change: Cost shown as a shield meter and the arc drawn in the HUD

originals.name: Revival tether
originals.idea: A support enemy channels a revive on a fallen ally within reach and a pitch gate.
originals.keep: Frame-gated channel, reach limit and pitch gate (game/m_medic.c 576-628)
originals.change: Revive at 40 percent HP after a 4 second wind-up

originals.name: Latch leech
originals.idea: A small enemy holds the player and drains on fixed ticks.

originals.name: Guard-stance brute
originals.idea: A visible guard before its attacks, with a dodge pause sized to the incoming projectile.
originals.change: The guard is a flashing shield

originals.name: Gib threshold as data
originals.idea: Each creature stores its overkill value; bosses sit far below zero, so they die by finisher.
originals.keep: Threshold as a field per creature (game/m_soldier.c 1256, game/m_boss31.c 729)
originals.change: Gibs become armour plates and sparks

originals.name: Dodge by time-to-impact
originals.idea: A 25 percent roll, then a pause sized to the projectile and a choice of duck or counter by difficulty.
originals.keep: Time-to-impact pause and difficulty-driven choice (game/g_weapon.c 32-52; game/m_soldier.c 828-868)
originals.change: A sidestep, and the choice weighted more toward counter

originals.name: Three-tier grunt
originals.idea: One model with three skins and HP steps of 20, 30 and 40.
originals.keep: Tier as skin variant and HP step (game/m_soldier.c 1238-1299)
originals.change: Tier shows as an armour plate tint
